race.comment: LENNY LINCOLN NZ (1) had a back row draw when he resumed with a sixth last start at Echuca. Has trialled well since so will have come on and should enjoy a nice run from the ace draw. MURPHYS REWARD NZ (6) settled in the leading division and kept finding for a 1.5m second here last start. Draws wider but is a primary contender with even luck. PIRANI PRINCESS (7) is another that will need things to go her way from a wide barrier but she is a player following a respectable second at her most recent appearance at Young. JOHNNYS BLUE (4) can feature again after showing improvement last start.
